newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht rises late, interbank rate steady.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht rises late, interbank rate steady.

text.p: The Thai baht was stronger against the dollar in late Wednesday trade in the domestic market on better baht sentiment boosted by the government's new economic package, dealers said.
The baht edged higher to 31.50/31.65 to the dollar late in the onshore market from 31.70/31.80 in early morning.
Dealers said the government's new set of economic programmes helped boost foreign investors' confidence and prompted exporters to offload their dollars.
"The market is seeing that the foreigners are confident about the measures in the finance sector," said one dealer at local bank.
"Exporters are also confident to bring money back especially if the baht is near 32," he added.

Thai government on Tuesday unveiled a set of reforms to help ease its economic woes after the baht came under fierce attack from investors worried about the country's excessive foreign borrowing and frail banking system.

The programme aims to secure about $15 billion in loans from the International Monetary Fund and foreign nations. It includes the suspension of operations of more than half the country's finance companies, a three percentage point rise in value added tax, and strict monetary and fiscal targets.
The eagerly-awaited plan was applauded by Japan and Washington.

Dealers said the market became cautious in the afternoon after Finance Minister Thanong Bidaya said Thailand would lift tht two-tier baht system imposed in mid-May to counter speculative attack on the currency. He gave no date for the change.

"There was some concern on the news. We feared that there would be another attack on the baht as the economic crisis remained unresolved and the foreign reserves is falling," said another dealer at a foreign bank.
In the offshore market, the baht was traded at 31.00/31.20 against 30.90/31.00 in the morning trade.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium was quoted at 11/16 satangs per dollar late in onshore market and 12/17 stangs in offshore market.
The overnight interbank rate was steady at 9.00-10.00 percent, unchanged from early morning trade.
